notes.title: Change of release date
notes.notes: 2020 was a pretty hard year, and even though the game is almost finished it needs a few more weeks in development. Most of the content is in place for the initial early access release, however, there are still a few things that needs to be finalized. Thank you for your patience, the wait is almost over!

notes.title: DEMO Update!
notes.notes:
The DEMO has been updated with some smaller fixes and improvements.

Notable changes:

On startup you get to pick a graphics preset to fit your pc and how you want the game to look.

You can now evade in all four directions by pressing the "crouch" key while walking!

Fixed issues with the prism.

Added more info about the saferoom.

Made the objective clearer.

Beyond that I really want to thank everyone who has tried out the demo this far, your support means a lot!
